item.title: Australia's Social Media Ban Deactivates Millions of Teen Accounts
item.description: Australia's new social media ban for under-16s has led to the deactivation of approximately 4.7 million teen accounts within its first month, according to the country's internet regulator. This swift impact signals the measure's effectiveness.

item.title: Spotify Increases Premium Subscription Price
item.description: Spotify is set to raise the monthly price of its premium subscription plan by USD 1 to USD 12.99. This adjustment will affect users in the United States, Estonia, and Latvia.

item.title: Wikipedia Marks 25 Years, Establishes Major AI Partnerships
item.description: Wikipedia has marked its 25th anniversary by announcing partnerships with several major artificial intelligence companies. This initiative aims to integrate the platform's extensive human-governed knowledge into AI systems at scale.

item.title: Uber WeChat Partnership Drives Chinese Tourist Demand
item.description: Uber Technologies' strategic partnership with Tencent Holdings' super app WeChat is yielding significant dividends. The ride-hailing operator is meeting a critical demand from Chinese travellers overseas.

item.title: OpenAI to Introduce Advertisements in ChatGPT to Boost Revenue
item.description: OpenAI will begin testing advertisements with select US ChatGPT users, aiming to boost revenue and finance the high development costs of its artificial intelligence technology. Credit: OpenAI These ads will be tested with users on the free tier and the globally expanding Go plan, appearing in the coming weeks. They will remain separate from answers generated by ChatGPT. Credit: OpenAI More expensive tiers, including Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise, will remain ad-free. OpenAI stated...

item.title: iPhone Displays May Diverge, Pro Models Hint at Under-Display Area
item.description: A recent leak indicates future iPhone models will present strikingly different display designs depending on the model, while some next-generation iPhones are anticipated to launch in Sept. This report details specifications for four devices: iPhone 18, second-generation iPhone Air, iPhone 18 Pro, and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

item.title: Tencent Seeks AI Collaboration to Enhance Support for Vulnerable Users
item.description: Tencent Research Institute (TRI) is seeking collaboration with major artificial intelligence (AI) developers to improve how generative AI services, including chatbots, interact with vulnerable users. This includes the elderly and left-behind children, who increasingly rely on these services for emotional support and health assistance.

item.title: DeepWisdom AI Agents Aid Solo Entrepreneurs with Code-Free Product Development
item.description: DeepWisdom, a Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) start-up, has launched its Atoms multi-agent application. The platform aims to help solo entrepreneurs develop finished products without writing a single line of code, deploying AI agents to serve in different roles.

item.title: AI and Jobs: Young Workers Most Concerned, Randstad Survey Reveals
item.description: A recent Randstad survey indicates four in five workers anticipate artificial intelligence will affect their daily workplace tasks, with Gen Z among those most concerned as companies increasingly rely on AI chatbots and automation, a survey conducted by Randstad showed on Tuesday.

item.title: Meta Appoints Dina Powell McCormick to Drive AI and Growth
item.description: Meta has named Dina Powell McCormick as its company president and vice chairperson. She previously served an eight-month tenure on Meta’s board of directors, stepping down in Dec.
